performance.verdict: Campaigns went dark Aug 6; 12-day spend blackout, not an efficiency story.

findings.text: All paid spend hit $0 on Aug 6 and has not recovered — 12 consecutive zero-spend days; 0 leads generated in that period.
Pre-blackout CPL was $26.04 over 28 days on 45 leads; no efficiency deterioration preceded the shutdown — campaigns paused at a working rate.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17) vs prior 3 (Aug 12–14): sc_clicks dropped from 25→6→4→0 vs 25→22→21 — organic search traffic collapsing with paid off.
GBP actions went 0→0→0 on Aug 15–17 vs avg 7.3/day the prior week — GBP engagement fading, likely tied to reduced brand search activity.
GHL shows 33 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments against 45 leads in 28 days — intake pipeline not converting leads to opps at all.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta campaigns immediately; pre-pause CPL was $26.04 — 12 days of confirmed zero output.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend went to $0 on Aug 6 and has not resumed for 12 days; the prior 28-day CPL was $26.04 on 45 leads, meaning campaigns were paused at a working rate. Sohib to confirm whether this was intentional (budget exhaustion, client pause request) or an error, then reactivate the 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' campaign or its replacement. Success check: spend resumes at prior daily rate (~$69–$84/day) and at least 1 lead recorded within 48 hours of reactivation. Confirm status by 2026-08-20.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake: 45 leads arrived, 0 opportunities created — confirm leads are routing to pipeline correctly.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts and 0 opportunities created against 45 Meta leads in the 28-day window — this is an intake leak, not an ads problem. Sohib to audit the GHL workflow: check that form submissions are triggering opportunity creation and confirm no stage mapping is broken. Success check: new leads post-reactivation appear as opportunities in GHL within 24 hours of submission. Review by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions and sc_clicks daily; if still at 0 by Aug 21, escalate as brand-signal decay requiring separate action.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks dropped to 0 on Aug 17 and GBP actions have been 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 15–17), consistent with brand search cooling when paid ads go dark. No action is warranted yet — this is expected correlation. Re-check sc_clicks and gbp_actions on Aug 21; if both remain at or near 0 after Meta reactivation, escalate as a separate organic/brand issue. No budget move this cycle.
